decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered Kew Bridge Entrance (Version 6), Received 24 August 2010 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the adverts are implemented.

Condition : 3 - Within three months of the removal of the adverts hereby approved, the mortar where the adverts were affixed shall be made good. The mortar shall match the existing mortar of the bridge.
Condition : 4 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface of the bridge.
Condition : 5 - There shall be no exterior lighting of the building.
description: Listed building consent for the erection of externally illuminated fascia signage to bridge arch.
